name: Osteria Verde

services.name: Private dining
services.description: Private dining room, minimum 8 guests, tasting menu

faqs.dietary: We can accommodate gluten-free, vegetarian, vegan, and most allergies. Please tell us when booking so the kitchen can prep.
faqs.corkage: $25 per bottle. Two-bottle maximum per table.
faqs.kids: Kids are welcome. Highchairs and a kids menu are available.
faqs.parking: Street parking on Elm St; a paid lot is one block north.
faqs.dress code: Smart casual. No shorts or flip-flops after 6pm.
faqs.cancellation: Please give 4 hours notice. Same-day cancellations are charged $15 per person.
faqs.gift cards: Available at the host stand or by phone. Any amount from $25.

voice_persona: warm, hospitable, quick to confirm details, uses guest's first name once
